method: Deterministic fixed-weight sensitivity extension across five lag allocations and four finite-grid delta values, with known-coefficient exact checks.
analysis_scope: Four archived monthly panels; coefficients and covariance deterministically restored with the archived fit settings because the archived JSON did not serialize beta; no outcome resampling.
class_claim: conditional deterministic sensitivity bounds for stated finite-grid fixed-allocation classes only

coverage_claim.interpretation: All reported M5 exact checks are deterministic known-coefficient sensitivity calculations, not empirical confidence-interval coverage estimates.

fit_settings.covariance: Primary component-specific two-way CR1: corrected region meat + corrected year meat - corrected region×year grouped intersection meat; use per-component group count correction × (n-1)/(n-p). Keep raw symmetric covariance; do not eigenvalue-clip the corrected covariance.
fit_settings.common_cr1_comparator: Use grouped region×year intersections and the same common min-cluster correction and PSD clipping policy as the source legacy covariance to isolate the intersection aggregation change.
fit_settings.legacy_covariance: Pinned source observation-level intersection subtraction, common min-cluster correction, and eigenvalue clipping for comparison only.
fit_settings.method_validity: Coefficient fit validity requires convergence, full design rank, and finite coefficients/estimate. Each method's interval additionally requires its own positive finite variance; failure of one covariance does not invalidate another method.
fit_settings.failed_interval_policy: Count planned replicate as uncovered for coverage; preserve failure and convergence flags; widths are summarized only among finite valid intervals with valid_n reported.

loader_metadata.lag_alignment: lag 1 is the same region's exposure at calendar month t-1; first rows and rows without an adjacent prior calendar month are dropped

details.knots_source: 15th, 50th, and 85th percentiles of all observed panel factual monthly temperatures before lag-row dropping
